content.text:
Welch Allyn ophthalmology/eye-exam tools are mainly **portable diagnostic instruments** used by clinicians for basic eye exams, retinal viewing, and refraction screening.

### Common Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools

| Tool | What it’s for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope** | Viewing the retina/optic disc | Wide-view direct ophthalmoscope; Welch Allyn says it provides a much larger viewing area than standard pocket/3.5V ophthalmoscopes and includes LED illumination and Quick Eye alignment lights. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **3.5V Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** | Standard direct ophthalmoscopy | Traditional Welch Allyn direct ophthalmoscope style, used in primary care, urgent care, med school, etc. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/3-5v-coaxial-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Prestige Coaxial-Plus Ophthalmoscope** | More advanced direct ophthalmoscopy | Uses coaxial optics, multiple focusing lenses, aperture/filter combinations, and is compatible with Welch Allyn 3.5V power sources. ([hillrom.co.uk](https://www.hillrom.co.uk/en/products/prestige-coaxial-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Elite Retinoscope** | Objective refraction / retinoscopy | Streak retinoscope with sealed optics, external focusing sleeve, glare-reducing polarizing filter, and compatibility with 3.5V power sources. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/elite-retinoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Ophthalmic Diagnostic Sets** | Bundled exam kits | Usually include an ophthalmoscope head, rechargeable 3.5V handle, charger/case, and sometimes a retinoscope or otoscope depending on the set. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **iExaminer Pro System** | Digital image capture add-on | Used with compatible PanOptic ophthalmoscopes to help capture fundus images with a smartphone-based system. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |

### If you’re choosing one

- **Medical student / PA / nursing / general exam use:** a basic **3.5V coaxial ophthalmoscope set** is usually enough.
- **Primary care or pediatrics:** **PanOptic Plus** is easier for many users because of the wider field of view.
- **Optometry / ophthalmology training:** consider both an **Elite retinoscope** and an **ophthalmoscope**, though many clinics also use slit lamps, BIO, fundus cameras, or 90D lenses.
- **Digital documentation:** look at **PanOptic Plus + iExaminer Pro**.

### Key compatibility point

Many Welch Allyn eye-exam heads are designed around the **Welch Allyn 3.5V handle/power-source system**, so if you already have a 3.5V rechargeable handle, check whether the head you’re buying is compatible before purchasing. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai))
